mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 34 degrees that feels like 26. Under tonight's full moon, the International Space Station will pass overhead, though you won't be able to see it due to the cloud cover.

Candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available from the City Clerk's Office for all four aldermanic districts, with paperwork due by January 5th. In tax news, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with the first installment due by January 31st.

There is plenty happening locally, including Live Music at Paddy Mac's and Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow features Hop Haus Trivia and ART House 360 Thursday Nights, while looking ahead, The Crafty Fair arrives on November 28th.
In police news, on Wednesday, November 4th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on East Verona Avenue and arrested a driver for O W I with a minor in the vehicle.
Today's Culver's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence, and the restaurant is open today until 10:00 PM.
